summary: A short note on where to find on-line documentation at SRI-ARC, whose NLS system hosted much of the early network's documents. It describes two files that guide users to documentation through links: a NIC locator file and a separate locator for the ARC system's own documents.

plainLanguage.summary: This RFC explains where users can find network and SRI-ARC documentation in NLS. It describes two locator files and how to display their instructions.

subtitle: How to find network and SRI-ARC documentation in NLS.

tldr.problem: Users needed help locating user documentation and other files available in NLS.
tldr.mechanism: The RFC describes two locator files: NIC LOCATOR for NIC functional documents and ARCLOCATOR for SRI-ARC system documentation.
tldr.outcome: Both files include instructions for their use in their first branch, and users are invited to suggest improvements.

today: The unit metadata lists RFC 544's status as Unknown. The RFC documents where to locate online files in NLS at SRI-ARC.

sections.title: Two Documentation Locator Files
sections.content:
RFC 544 says that users now have two files to help locate documentation and other files in NLS. NIC LOCATOR leads users to NIC functional documents.

A branch labeled ARC SYSTEM DOCUMENTATION in NIC LOCATOR directs users to ARCLOCATOR, which includes documentation of the SRI-ARC system.
sections.plainLanguage: NIC LOCATOR leads to NIC documents, including a branch for SRI-ARC documentation. ARCLOCATOR contains documents about the SRI-ARC system.

sections.title: Instructions for Using the Files
sections.content:
The RFC says both locator files are formatted to make documents easy to access for inexperienced NLS users. Each file includes instructions for its own use in branch one.

To see the instructions in NIC LOCATOR, the RFC gives commands to load the file and print branch .1.
sections.plainLanguage: Each locator file includes instructions in its first branch. The RFC shows commands for loading NIC LOCATOR and printing those instructions.

sections.title: Suggestions and Updates
sections.content: The authors invite users to send ideas and suggestions about the LOCATOR files to KIRK or NDM at SRI-ARC. The notice does not describe a general search system beyond these locator files.
sections.plainLanguage: Users can send suggestions about the locator files to the named SRI-ARC contacts. The RFC focuses on locating documents with these files.
